case.title: One date for both, the auto loan is clamped across Founders' Day
case.script: Verified. Asks whether she is talking to a robot. Cannot pay today. Wants to pay both on Friday the 30th. Accepts when told the auto loan has an earlier latest date, and confirms.
checks: robot answer: 'I am Northwind Credit Union's automated assistant.'
card recorded on 30 October (early-band deadline 3 November skips 19 Oct and 2 Nov)
auto loan recorded on its own deadline Thu 22 October (3rd business day, Monday 19 October is Founders' Day)
